extras: Previously known as Watermark Bucket Uploader.
intentEvidence: Previously Watermark Bucket Uploader. Existing installations and settings continue to work normally.
problem: Manually uploading images to external storage and managing large file sizes within Obsidian notes.
summary: A zero-friction image uploader that intercepts pasted or dragged files, optimizes them, uploads them to S3-compatible storage, and inserts a Markdown link into the note.
